blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Medical images encode intrinsic tissue properties that indicate disease progression, yet these properties remain entangled with the system-dependent physics of image formation. Differentiable inverse rendering asks whether they are recoverable by inverting the imaging system's forward physics rather than through post-hoc correction. We address this in optical coherence tomography (OCT), focusing on the optical attenuation coefficient, a per-pixel marker of pathology and cellular composition. Conventional recovery relies on closed-form inversions limited to simplified light-tissue models, or learned methods coupled to specific imaging configurations. We instead recover per-pixel attenuation from a single OCT image by gradient descent through a differentiable physics-based forward model. We verified the method against analytical solutions, validated it on five in vitro phantoms, and applied it without modification to 29{,}269 clinical intravascular OCT images from 128 patients. The inversion needs no training data or segmentations and is portable across platforms and retrospective archives. Replacing the forward model or recovering another optical parameter leaves the optimization procedure unchanged. We demonstrate per-pixel recovery is tractable because gradient information scales to this high-dimensional problem, where gradient-free methods become intractable. Our work supports quantitative tissue characterization from OCT images and provides a framework for extension across imaging modalities and organ systems.
blocks.zh: 医学影像编码了内在组织属性,这些属性表明疾病的发展,然而这些属性仍然与图像形成系统依赖的物理相缠. 可分辨的反向渲染质质问它们是否可以通过倒置成像系统的前向物理,而不是通过后向修正来恢复. 我们在光学一致性成像法(OCT)中处理这一问题,重点是光学衰减系数、病理和细胞组成的每像素标记。 常规恢复依赖于封闭式倒置,仅限于简化的轻质问题模型,或与特定成像配置相结合的学习方法. 相反,我们通过一个基于物理学的不同前向模型,通过梯度下降,从单个OCT图像中恢复出每像素的衰减。 我们对照分析解决方案验证了方法,验证了5个体外幽灵,并且不加修改地应用到128个患者的29{,}269个临床血管内OCT图像上. 反相不需要培训数据或分区,而且跨平台和追溯档案可移植。 替换前置模型或回收另一个光学参数,使得优化程序不变. 我们显示每个像素的恢复是可拉动的, 因为梯度信息尺度 到了这个高维度的问题, 在那里,无梯度的方法变得棘手。 我们的工作支持从OCT图像中进行定量组织特征鉴定,并提供一个跨成像模式和器官系统的扩展框架。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The interrogation of biological matter through diverse forms of energy constitutes the foundation of modern medical diagnostic practice. Whether utilizing magnetic gradients in magnetic resonance imaging Berger (2002) , high-frequency sound waves in ultrasound Harvey et al. (2002) , ionizing radiation in computed tomography Buzug (2011) , or backscattered light in optical coherence tomography (OCT) Drexler and Fujimoto (2008) , modern imaging modalities share a common operative principle. They apply energy to tissue and infer anatomy from how the energy is differentially reflected, scattered, or absorbed by the underlying material Shung et al. (2012) . Historically, the advancement of these technologies has focused on hardware innovations to improve spatial resolution and contrast, providing clinicians with high-fidelity anatomical visualizations of organ systems and diseased tissue Webb (2022) ; Oppelt (2006) . However, while these anatomical maps are essential, they are not direct measurements of tissue composition: each image is a projection of the underlying intrinsic properties through the physics of the imaging system, entangling composition with modality-specific acquisition artifacts. In clinical applications, intrinsic properties such as stiffness, conductivity, and pH dictate disease progression and physiological stability Levental et al. (2009) ; Webb et al. (2011) ; Gabriel et al. (1996) , yet remain inaccessible from the projected image alone. This paper inverts that projection. Although the imaging chain is a complex, modality-specific forward operator whose inverse is ill-posed, we demonstrate intrinsic tissue composition can be recovered directly from clinical imaging through differentiable inverse rendering, with OCT as our case study.
blocks.zh: 通过不同形式的能量对生物物质进行询问,是现代医学诊断实践的基础. 无论是在磁共振成像Berger(2002年)、在超声波Harvey等(2002年)、在计算成像图Buzug(2011年)中的电离辐射,还是在光学一致性成像图(OCT)Drexler和藤本(2008年)中反向散射光,现代成像模式都有一个共同的运作原则。 它们将能量用于组织,并推断出能量是如何被不同程度的反射、分散或被Shung等人(2012年)所吸收的。 历史上,这些技术的进步主要集中在硬件创新上,以改善空间分辨率和对比度,为临床医生提供了器官系统和有病组织Webb的高真性解剖可视性(2022);Oppelt(2006). 然而,虽然这些解剖图是必不可少的,但它们并不是组织构成的直接测量:每个图像都是通过成像系统的物理学对内在属性的投影,将构成与特定模式的获取文物相融合. 在临床应用中,硬度、导电性和pH等内在性质决定了疾病的发展和生理稳定性Levental等人(2009年);Webb等人(2011年);Gabriel等人(1996年),但仅从预测的图像看,仍然无法进入。 这篇论文颠倒了投影. 虽然成像链是一个复杂,特定模式的前进操作器,反向的投放情况不佳,但我们证明了内在的组织组成可以通过不同的反向渲染直接从临床成像中恢复,以OCT作为我们的案例研究.

blocks.en: The technical foundation for this inversion comes from parallel development in computer vision. Physics-based forward models have been refined in medical imaging Webb (2022) , yet they are almost exclusively used in alternate directions. They simulate, correct, or render images rather than recover tissue properties from them. The computer vision community is closing an analogous gap through differentiable rendering Li et al. (2018) ; Pharr et al. (2023) , which treats the image-formation process as a differentiable function and uses gradient-based optimization to recover scene parameters from observed images Mildenhall et al. (2021) . The principle that gradient descent can invert any differentiable forward model to recover its input extends naturally beyond natural images and has begun to enter medical imaging in modality-specific applications such as x-ray and ultrasound Gopalakrishnan et al. (2024) ; Bertramo et al. (2025) ; Finkelstein et al. (2025) ; Simson et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 这种倒置的技术基础来自计算机视觉的平行发展. 医学成像Webb(2022年)对以物理为基础的前方模型进行了改进,但几乎完全用于其他方向。 它们模拟、正确或制造图像,而不是从中恢复组织特性。 计算机视界正在通过可分异渲染的Li等人(2018年);Pharr等人(2023年),将图像成形过程视为可分异函数,并采用梯度优化,从所观测到的图像Mildenhall等人(2021年)中取回场景参数. 梯度下降可以颠倒任何可分辨的前向模型来恢复其输入量的原则自然地超越了自然图像,并开始以克射线和超声波Gopalakrishnan等人(2024年); Bertramo等人(2025年); Finkelstein等人(2025年); Simson等人(2023年)等特定模式应用进入医学成像.

blocks.en: In biomedical optical imaging, the optical attenuation coefficient (OAC) is a particularly informative quantitative tissue property, characterizing how rapidly the signal is attenuated with depth. Attenuation serves as a robust discriminator of pathology across both acoustic Kuc (2007) ; Berger et al. (1990) ; Sagar et al. (1990) ; Sugata et al. (1992) and optical Xu et al. (2008) ; McLaughlin et al. (2010) ; Barwari et al. (2011) ; Barwari et al. (2012) ; Tomlins et al. (2010) ; Zhang et al. (2012) ; Van Der Schoot et al. (2012) regimes, and is sensitive to fundamental cellular mechanisms, including necrosis and apoptosis van der Meer et al. (2010) , making it a functional proxy for tissue viability beyond the shape and size of anatomical features captured by standard imaging. While IV-OCT provides high anatomical resolution Huang et al. (1991) ; Bouma et al. (2017) , the image entangles the OAC with the effects of complex wave propagation and system-specific acquisition parameters, making it difficult to extract intrinsic composition from image intensity Stone et al. (2011) ; Virmani et al. (2000) .
blocks.zh: 在生物医学光学成像中,光学衰减系数(OAC)是一个特别信息化的定量组织属性,特征是信号被深度削弱的速度如何快. 强化对病理学的强烈歧视,既涉及声学库克(2007年);Berger等人(1990年);Sagar等人(1990年);Sugata等人(1992年)和光学徐等人(2008年);McLaughlin等人(2010年);Barwari等人(2011年);Barwari等人(2012年);Tomlins等人(2010年); 张等 (2012年); 范德舒等. (2012年)制度,对基本细胞机制敏感,包括坏死和opotosis van der Meer等人(2010年),使其成为标准成像所捕获的解剖特征外形和大小的组织可行性的功能代名词. 虽然IV-OCT提供了高解剖分解分辨率Huang等(1991年);Bouma等(2017年),但图像将OAC与复杂的波传播和系统特定获取参数相缠绕,因此难以从图像强度Stone等(2011年);Virmani等(2000年)。

blocks.en: Other biomedical optical modalities recover different optical properties. Photoacoustic and diffuse optical methods derive contrast from optical absorption , where quantitative recovery is itself an ill-posed problem because the internal fluence is unknown Wang and Hu (2012) ; Cox et al. (2012) , and intravascular photoacoustic catheters remain preclinical Iskander-Rizk et al. (2019) . OCT attenuation is instead dominated by scattering, the mechanism carrying lipid, calcium, and cellular density information in plaque Yabushita et al. (2002) ; Van Soest et al. (2010) , and is well established as a quantitative marker across many tissue types Scolaro et al. (2012) ; Cauberg et al. (2010) ; Gong et al. (2014) ; Qin et al. (2021) ; Almasian et al. (2015) . Because IV-OCT is already standard of care during percutaneous coronary intervention Tearney et al. (2012) ; Yonetsu and Jang (2024) , inverting its image formation extracts an additional quantitative channel from images that are already acquired. OCT is a case study here as the framework requires only that the forward operator be differentiable with respect to the property of interest.
blocks.zh: 其他生物医学光学模式恢复了不同的光学特性. 光声学和扩散光学方法从光学吸收中衍生出对比,其中定量恢复本身就是一个不易出现的问题,因为内部流畅度未知的为王和胡(2012年); Cox等. (2012),而血管内光声导管仍为临床前的Iskander-Rizk等 (2019). 相反,OCT的衰减主要是散射、带脂质、钙和细胞密度信息的机制,见于Plaque Yabushita等人(2002年); Soest等人(2010年),并被确立为许多组织类型Scolaro等人(2012年);Cauberg等人(2010年);Gong等人(2014年);Qin等人(2021年);Almasian等人(2015年)。 由于IV-OCT已经是皮下冠状干预期间的护理标准 Tearney 等 (2012年); Yonetsu 和 Jang (2024年),倒置其图像形成从已经获得的图像中提取出额外的定量通道. 在此,OCT是一个案例研究,因为框架只要求远期运营商在利益财产方面有不同。

blocks.en: Existing approaches to OCT attenuation recovery fall into three categories Chang and Bowden (2019) . Curve-fitting (CF) methods extract a single attenuation coefficient by fitting signal decay over a manually segmented region van der Meer et al. (2005) , which is robust for uniform tissues but unable to capture intra-tissue heterogeneity. Depth-resolved (DR) methods compute per-pixel attenuation from the ratio of local intensity to remaining energy Vermeer et al. (2013) ; Liu et al. (2017) , but the closed-form formulation constrains them to single-scattering assumptions and makes the resulting maps sensitive to noise sources like speckle and local signal artifacts. Recent work in this area addresses the noise sensitivity issue using despeckling to improve local region homogeneity Cannon et al. (2021) . Learning-based methods can incorporate richer forward physics through synthetic training data Yu et al. (2026) , but the learned amortized inverse is fixed after training and coupled to the simulated distribution. The stationary iteration method estimates depth-dependent attenuation and backscattering without explicit layer segmentation Wang et al. (2023) , and optimization also estimates these parameters via an implicit neural representation of optical properties through an OCT imaging model using multi-angle measurements Li et al. (2025) . Our method instead optimizes any differentiable forward model by gradient descent from a single B-scan.
blocks.zh: 现有的OCT衰减回收办法分为常和鲍登三类(2019年)。 曲线调整方法通过在van der Meer等人(2005年)手动分块区域上安装信号衰变来提取出单一的衰减系数,这个区域对统一组织很强,但无法捕捉组织内部的异质性。 深度解(DR)方法计算出从局部强度与余能Vermeer等(2013年);刘等(2017年)的比分中每像素的衰减率,但封闭式配方使其受单发假说所制约,并使得所生成的地图对Speekle等噪声源和局部信号文物具有敏感性. 这一领域的近期工作涉及噪声敏感性问题,利用分光来改进当地地区的同质性Cannon等人(2021年)。 以学习为基础的方法可以通过合成训练数据Yu等(2026年)纳入更丰富的前向物理,但所学习到的分期还原在训练后固定下来,并结合模拟分布. 固定迭代法估算了深度依赖衰减和回旋而无分层分解的Wang等人(2023年),并优化后通过使用多角测量的OCT成像模型Li等人(2025年),通过隐含神经表达光学特性来估计出这些参数. 我们的方法通过梯度下降 优化了任何不同的前进模式 与单一B型扫描。

blocks.en: Our work targets a central question in differentiable inverse rendering of whether intrinsic tissue properties can be inferred directly from medical images by framing property recovery as the inverse of the imaging system’s forward physics. To examine this in OCT, we built an automated and generalizable physics-based inverse rendering framework that extracts intrinsic tissue properties directly from standard clinical OCT images without the need for segmentations. The framework addresses all three limitations in a single formulation by delivering per-pixel attenuation while operating on an explicit forward model that can incorporate arbitrary physics and optimizing each image independently. Because the forward model is modular, incorporating additional scattering physics, such as the Extended Huygens-Fresnel model Thrane et al. (2000) , or recovering further optical parameters requires only modifying the forward model, not the inversion procedure.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作针对一个中心问题,即能否通过将财产回收设定为成像系统前方物理学的反向,直接从医疗图像中推断出内在组织特性。 为了在OCT中检查这一点,我们建立了一个自动化的和通俗化的以物理学为基础的反向渲染框架,直接从标准的临床OCT图像中提取出内在组织属性而不需要分解. 该框架通过提供每像素衰减,同时在可以包含任意物理和独立优化每个图像的明确前行模型上运作,解决了单一配方中的所有三个局限性. 因为前向模型是模块化的,融合了额外的散射物理,例如扩展惠更斯-弗雷斯内尔模型. Thrane等人(2000年),或恢复进一步的光学参数,只需要修改前向模型,而不是反向程序.

blocks.en: By inverting the path-integrated Beer-Lambert (B-L) model Oshina and Spigulis (2021) , we recovered depth-resolved, pixel-level OAC maps. We verified our method on five optically homogeneous physical phantoms against the conventional CF method and applied it to 29,269 clinical coronary IV-OCT frames Ali et al. (2017) ; Ali et al. (2019) ; Kereiakes et al. (2023) ; Saito et al. (2022) (over a 128-patient intravascular lithotripsy cohort) to demonstrate spatially resolved attenuation recovery and faithful image rendering across varying vessel morphologies. IV-OCT routinely guides percutaneous coronary intervention. Images are acquired with a catheter-based scanner that illuminates the arterial wall with a near-infrared laser and reconstructs depth-resolved cross-sections from the backscattered light. Current clinical practice relies on viewing anatomical features such as plaque shape and size, while treatment decisions depend on tissue composition. These results support the potential of per-pixel OAC maps to enable quantitative plaque characterization and guide interventional decision-making van der Meer et al. (2010) ; Fujino et al. (2018) .
blocks.zh: 通过倒置路径集成的啤酒-兰伯特(B-L)模型Oshina和Spigulis (2021),我们恢复了深度解析,像素级的OAC地图. 我们对照常规的CF方法验证了我们在五个光学同质物理幻象上的方法,并将其应用于29,269个临床冠状物IV-OCT框架Ali等(2017年);Ali等(2019年);Kereiakes等(2023年);Saito等(超过128个患者的血管通体群),以展示空间已解的衰减恢复和不同船只形态的忠实图像渲染。 IV-OCT定期指导皮下冠状干预. 图像是用导管扫描仪获得的,该扫描仪用近红外激光照射动脉壁并从后向散射光线上重建出深解截面. 目前的临床实践依赖于取景解剖特征,如平板形状和大小等,而治疗决定则取决于组织组成. 这些结果支持了每像素OAC地图的潜力,从而能够量化地标特征并指导干预决策 van der Meer等(2010年); Fujino等 (2018年).

blocks.en: The differentiable inverse rendering approach generalizes to any imaging modality whose forward physics can be expressed as a differentiable operator. Changing the forward physics can change the properties that are recovered. We can also control the optimization loop, loss function, and regularization framework to guide optimization. Our work demonstrates this paradigm in OCT, joining differentiable forward models already demonstrated for other modalities across physics-based medical imaging Chen et al. (2025) ; Barbastathis et al. (2019) . We make the following contributions: • A gradient-based differentiable inverse rendering framework for per-pixel optical attenuation recovery from OCT images without training data or prior segmentation. • Quantitative validation against curve-fitting references across 5,120 B-scan inversions on 5 physical liquid intralipid phantoms each imaged at two focal positions, with systematic characterization of optimizer reproducibility, noise robustness, and parameter sensitivity in agar phantoms. • Retrospective application to 128 clinical IV-OCT coronary pullbacks of atherosclerotic tissue demonstrating spatially resolved attenuation and backscattering recovery. Differentiable inverse rendering posits that intrinsic property recovery from images can be cast as a tractable inverse problem driven by gradient information. Our work contributes evidence for this paradigm in biomedical imaging, with OCT as the use case. We introduce a differentiable inverse rendering framework for OCT with validation across phantoms and demonstration in clinical acquisitions. Gradient information is vital because it captures the intrinsic relationships between tissue regions and guides the optimizer toward a physically consistent solution. The inversion is portable across different imaging systems and applicable to retrospective clinical archives, addressing the domain-shift barrier in clinical AI deployment. Gradient descent through an explicit forward model decouples the complexity of the physics from the availability of an inverse, whereas closed-form estimators require physics simple enough to invert analytically and learned estimators are bound to their training distribution, making the forward model a replaceable component and the approach transferable beyond OCT.
blocks.zh: 相异的反向渲染方法一般化为任何能被表达出前向物理的成像模式,以不同的操作者来表示. 改变前向物理可以改变被恢复的属性. 我们还可以控制优化循环,损失功能,规范化框架来引导优化. 我们的工作在OCT中展示了这一范式,加入了已经为基于物理学的医学成像陈等(2025年);Barbastathis等(2019年)。 我们作出以下贡献: 一个基于梯度的不同反向渲染框架,用于每像素光学衰减从OCT图像中恢复而无需培训数据或事先分解。 • 对5 120 B-扫描反向5个物理液态内脂幻象的曲线相适应参考进行定量验证,每幅图像在两个焦点位置上成像,对优化再生性、噪音稳健性以及agar幻象中的参数敏感性进行系统定性。 • 对128个临床IV-OCT冠状组织进行回溯性应用,显示空间已分解的衰减和回旋恢复。 不同的反向渲染假设,从图像中取回的固有财产可以被推为由梯度信息驱动的可拉动倒向问题。 我们的工作为生物医学成像中的这种范式提供了证据,以OCT为例。 我们为OCT引入了一种不同的反向渲染框架,通过对幽灵的验证和临床采购的演示. 渐进信息至关重要,因为它能捕捉组织区域之间的内在关系并引导优化者走向物理上一致的解决方案. 反相可跨出不同的成像系统,适用于可追溯的临床档案,解决临床AI部署中的域-转移障碍. 通过一个明确的前向模型使物理的复杂性与反向的可得性脱钩,而闭式估计器则需要物理上足够简单,可以进行反向分析,而有学识的估计器则与其训练分布相接,使前向模型成为可替换的组成部分,方法可转移于OCT之外.

blocks.en: A gradient-based differentiable inverse rendering framework for per-pixel optical attenuation recovery from OCT images without training data or prior segmentation.
blocks.zh: 基于梯度的不同反向渲染框架,用于从OCT图像中进行每像素光学衰减回收,而无需培训数据或事先分解.

blocks.en: Quantitative validation against curve-fitting references across 5,120 B-scan inversions on 5 physical liquid intralipid phantoms each imaged at two focal positions, with systematic characterization of optimizer reproducibility, noise robustness, and parameter sensitivity in agar phantoms.
blocks.zh: 以5,120 B-scan反向5个物理液态内脂幽灵的曲线相适应参考进行定量验证,每个图像在两个焦点上成像,系统定性优化器可再生性,噪声稳健性,以及agar幽灵中的参数灵敏度.

blocks.zh: 对128个临床IV-OCT冠状后拉组织进行回溯应用,显示空间已分解的衰减和回旋恢复.

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: Our method takes a single OCT image as input along with prespecified scanner and optimization parameters. It returns a per-pixel map of the optical attenuation coefficient μ \mu . An OCT image is composed of depth profiles called A-lines; a two-dimensional cross-section (B-scan) is formed by laterally concatenating adjacent A-lines. The framework operates by passing a candidate attenuation map through a differentiable forward model that simulates a simplified OCT image by combining Beer-Lambert attenuation with confocal amplitude modulation, then iteratively updating μ \mu by gradient descent to minimize the discrepancy between the simulated and measured B-scan. We first verify the forward and inverse components on synthetic data before applying the framework to physical phantoms and clinical intravascular OCT images.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法将单个OCT图像与预先指定的扫描仪和优化参数一起作为输入. 它返回光学衰减系数 μ\mu 的每像素映射 。 OCT图像由深度剖面组成,称为A-行;由相邻A-行平面相接而成的二维截面(B-scan). 该框架的运作方式是通过一个不同的前向模型传递一个候选衰减图来模拟一个简化的OCT图像,将啤酒-兰伯特衰减与交联振幅调制相结合,再以梯度降下来迭代更新μ\mu来将模拟和被测量的B-scan相差最小. 我们首先验证合成数据上的前向和反向成分,然后将框架应用于物理幻象和临床血管内OCT图像.

blocks.en: Forward and inverse models achieve exact recovery on computational phantoms
blocks.zh: 前向和倒向模型在计算幽灵上实现精确回收

blocks.en: We compared four optimizers while increasing the number of axially coupled attenuation parameters within one synthetic A-line from 25 to 5,000 across eight problem sizes ( Figure 1 ). All methods shared the forward model, bounds, and eight paired initializations, with solver-specific optimization budgets. All achieved below 0.1% mean MAPE at the smallest size. While Adam and L-BFGS-B maintained this accuracy throughout, Random Search and CMA-ES became worse reaching MAPE values of 30.32% and 100.91% respectively. Supplementary experiments examined lateral scaling on synthetic data, measured-data recovery, and A-line coupling (Supplementary Figure 1). At 475 parameters on the measured A-line with axial TV, the gradient-based methods achieved lower intensity MSE and closer CF agreement. With fixed gain and no lateral TV, each A-line can be optimized independently using the mean squared error between predicted and measured intensities and the axial TV regularizer that couples neighboring pixels in a single A-line together by penalizing differences in attenuation. Lateral TV couples neighboring A-lines together within a B-scan. Estimating one gain from the entire B-scan also couples the A-lines because each A-line contributes to the shared gain. We therefore optimize all A-lines in a B-scan together in the agar-phantom and clinical inversions.

blocks.en: The differentiable forward model was first verified against the analytical Beer-Lambert solution. Representative A-line profiles for 2-, 3-, and 4-layer configurations confirm numerical agreement ( Figure 2 a–f). blocks.en: The inverse optimization was then evaluated on 500 synthetic B-scans generated by the forward model from randomized ground-truth attenuation maps, testing whether the optimizer can recover known attenuation maps from its own rendered image. We show one example B-scan optimization result ( Figure 2 j–o), concordance scatter plots at four optimization snapshots across all 500 phantoms ( Figure 2 p–s), and the full convergence trajectory of MAPE and R 2 R^{2} over 30,000 iterations ( Figure 2 t). Each attenuation map was initialized from scrambled conditions ( R 2 < 0.0001 R^{2}<0.0001 , MAPE = 77.0 % =77.0\% ; Figure 2 j,p), and the optimizer converged monotonically to near-perfect recovery ( Figure 2 t). Across all 500 phantoms, the recovered tissue μ \mu achieved final MAPE = 0.15 % =0.15\% , concordance R 2 = 0.9997 R^{2}=0.9997 , MAE = 0.007 ± 0.001 =0.007\pm 0.001 mm -1 , and regression slope = 0.998 =0.998 . These results confirm the numerical correctness of both the forward operator and the optimization procedure, establishing a baseline for evaluation on physical phantoms. Recovery under forward-model mismatch is evaluated in Supplementary Note 7.

blocks.en: Recovered attenuation tracks scatterer concentration across physical phantoms
blocks.zh: 物理幻觉中的散射器浓度

blocks.en: Physical phantoms provide a controlled setting in which the imaging system parameters are fully specified and reference attenuation values are available from conventional curve-fitting analysis, enabling direct quantitative comparison with the optimization-based recovery. All 512 B-scans per acquisition were processed independently using the single-scattering forward model, totaling 5,120 B-scan inversions across five liquid intralipid phantoms (0.5–3.0%) each imaged at two focal positions (H and L; Figure 3 a–c). The optimization workflow on a representative 5.0% intralipid-in-agar B-scan is shown in Supplementary Figure 2d–i, with the recovered μ \mu volume for the 3.0% H liquid acquisition ( Figure 3 d,e) demonstrating spatially coherent attenuation within the tissue band.

Frame-to-frame variability was low (standard deviation 0.025 0.025 – 0.053 0.053 mm -1 across 512 B-scans per volume). Each concentration was imaged at two focal positions; H and L yielded slopes of 0.663 0.663 and 0.629 0.629 mm -1 % with R 2 = 0.990 R^{2}=0.990 and R 2 = 0.993 R^{2}=0.993 , comparable to the CF reference (slopes of 0.623 0.623 and 0.625 0.625 mm -1 %). blocks.en: Attenuation recovery is reproducible across initializations and robust to noise
blocks.zh: 加速回收在初始化过程中是可以复制的,强能发出噪音

blocks.en: The identifiability study quantified the reproducibility of the recovered attenuation under two distinct perturbations of the initialization: the random draw of the initial μ \mu map from a fixed distribution (seed sweep), and the width and location of the initialization distribution itself (range sweep) ( Figure 4 a–d). In the seed sweep, each acquisition was optimized 20 times with independent initializations drawn from a fixed uniform distribution ( Figure 4 a). Intra-acquisition coefficients of variation (CoV) ranged from 0.18 % 0.18\% to 0.32 % 0.32\% across the 10 acquisitions (mean = 0.27 ± 0.04 % =0.27\pm 0.04\% ; Figure 4 c), indicating that, given a fixed initialization distribution, the optimizer yields reproducible tissue-mean attenuation.
blocks.zh: 可识别性研究量化了初始化的两个明显扰动下所回收的衰减的可再生性:从固定分布(种子扫荡)中随机抽取出初始的μ\mu映射,初始化分布本身的宽度和位置(范围扫荡)(图4 a-d). 在种子扫瞄中,每次收购均被优化了20次,从固定的统一分配中抽取出独立初始化(图4 a). 10项收购(平均=0.27 ± 0.04%=0.27\pm 0.04+;图4c)的购买内变异系数介于0.18%-0.18\%至0.32%-0.32\%之间,表明如果有固定的初始化分布,优化者会产生可再生的组织-增减。

blocks.en: In the range sweep, 10 distinct ranges for the uniform distribution were tested with 5 seeds per condition ( Figure 4 b), spanning narrow ( [ 3 , 7 ] [3,7] mm -1 ), wide ( [ 0 , 10 ] [0,10] , [ 0 , 20 ] [0,20] mm -1 ), fixed-value ( [ 1 , 1 ] [1,1] , [ 5 , 5 ] [5,5] , [ 10 , 10 ] [10,10] , [ 15 , 15 ] [15,15] mm -1 ), biased ( [ 7 , 15 ] [7,15] mm -1 ), and informed (CF reference) conditions. Seven of the 10 conditions yielded consistent recovery across all 10 acquisitions: after averaging the five seeds per condition, every condition mean was within ± 25 % \pm 25\% of the corresponding acquisition’s mean across these seven conditions. The corresponding per-acquisition initialization range CoV was 2.1 % 2.1\% – 13.1 % 13.1\% ( Figure 4 c,d). The three conditions [ 0 , 3 ] [0,3] , [ 1 , 1 ] [1,1] , and [ 15 , 15 ] [15,15] mm -1 failed this criterion and yielded different recovered values, consistent with the non-convexity expected from the cumulative-sum forward operator. This criterion describes numerical consistency rather than accuracy, since pixel-wise ground truth is unavailable for measured data. Initialization-induced uncertainty in the clinical maps is quantified in Supplementary Note 8.
blocks.zh: 在射程扫射中,对统一分布的10个不同范围进行了测试,每个条件有5个种子(图4b),范围窄([3、7] [3、7] 毫米-1],宽(0、10] [0、10] [0、20] [0、20] [20] 毫米-1],定值([1、1]、[5、5] [5、5] 5],[10、10] [10、10] [15、15] [15、15] 毫米-1],偏差(7、15] [7、15] 毫米-1),以及知情(CF参考)条件。 10个条件中的7个使得所有10个条件都得到了一致的恢复:每个条件平均有5个种子之后,每个条件的平均值都不超过这7个条件相应获得的平均值的±25%\pm 25%。 相应的每个购置初始化范围CoV为2.1% 2.1%-13.1%-13.1%-(图4c,d)。 三个条件[0, 3] [0, 3], [1, 1], [15, 15] [15, 15] mm-1] 都未能达到这一标准,并得出了不同的回收值, 符合从累计总和远期运营商预期得到的非一致性. 这个标准描述的是数值一致性而不是准确性,因为对于所测量的数据来说,没有像素偏上地面的真伪. 临床图中初始化引起的不确定性在补充说明8中量化.

blocks.en: The noise robustness study quantified how additive Gaussian noise degrades recovery across all 10 acquisitions over a sweep from SNR = − 3 =-3 dB up to each phantom’s baseline acquisition SNR in 1 dB steps ( Figure 4 e–g). Following the noise model in OCT Uribe-Patarroyo et al. (2020) , zero-mean circular Gaussian noise was added to each complex-valued B-scan at a controlled SNR computed using the rigorous definition that accounts for the noise floor bias in the numerator. For every phantom, three recovery metrics tracked SNR consistently. Recovered tissue μ \mu deviated only marginally from the noiseless baseline over the first 4–5 dB of added noise and then diverged sharply as SNR fell further ( Figure 4 g). Baseline concordance R 2 R^{2} (recovered μ \mu versus its noiseless recovery) increased monotonically with SNR across every phantom. The spatial standard deviation of recovered tissue μ \mu decreased monotonically with SNR, reflecting smoother and more spatially consistent recoveries at high SNR.

blocks.en: Recovered attenuation maps generalize to clinical intravascular OCT
blocks.zh: 将恢复的衰减图归纳到临床血管内

blocks.en: To demonstrate the method transfers from phantoms to clinical acquisition, the framework was applied to intravascular OCT with the same optimization algorithm and reconstruction loss, without TV regularization. Per-frame optimization was run independently on 29,269 cross-sections spanning 128 separate patient pullbacks drawn from four clinical trial cohorts Ali et al. (2017) ; Ali et al. (2019) ; Kereiakes et al. (2023) ; Saito et al. (2022) ; each Cartesian frame was converted to a polar representation for optimization. Each frame is solved independently, as the method carries no state or learned parameters between frames. Figure 5 shows 5 example frames from a single representative pullback. Because scanner-specific calibration metadata was unavailable for this acquisition, we adopted measured confocal parameters reported for the C7-XR / Dragonfly catheter family ( z R = 0.59 z_{R}=0.59 mm, z f = 1.06 z_{f}=1.06 mm) Gargesha et al. (2015) , together with an axial pixel size of 0.01932 0.01932 mm/pixel estimated from the ILUMIEN OPTIS A-scan range. Combined with the undocumented post-processing transformations applied to the log-compressed clinical images, the recovered attenuation values capture relative tissue contrast rather than absolute quantities.
blocks.zh: 为了证明从幽灵到临床获取的方法转移,该框架被应用于血管内OCT,其优化算法与重建损失相同,没有电视规范化. 每帧优化在29,269个横截面上独立运行,从4个临床试验组群中抽取128个单独的病人后退(Ali等 (2017年);Ali等 (2019年);Kereiakes等 (2023年);Saito等 (2022年);每个笛卡尔框架被转换为极地代表以优化. 每个帧都是独立解决的,因为方法在帧之间没有带状态或学到的参数. 图5显示5个实例框架,取自单一代表性的取出。 由于这次收购没有扫描仪专用的校正元数据,因此我们采用了C7-XR/龙蝇导管家族(z R=0.59 z_{R}=0.59 mm;z f=1.06 z_{f}=1.06 mm)Gargesha等人(2015年)的测得的同位素参数,以及根据ILUMIEN OPIS A-scan范围估计的轴像素大小为0.019320.01932 mm/像素. 与对日志压缩的临床图像适用的无记录的加工后变相相结合,恢复的衰减值捕捉相对组织对比,而不是绝对数量。

blocks.en: The per-pixel attenuation coefficient μ \mu was first optimized with the backscattering fraction α \alpha held fixed at unity (Stage 1) assuming a 15 dB noise floor. Across every frame of every patient, the recovered OAC maps are spatially resolved and track the tissue architecture visible in the raw images, resolving the vessel wall, lumen boundary, and calcified plaque deposits, confirming that the framework generalizes from controlled phantom to the complex radial scan of catheter-based IV-OCT. Using the recovered μ \mu maps, the forward model synthesizes rendered IV-OCT images that reproduce the overall geometry of each cross-section. Aggregated over all 29,269 frames, rendered and target B-scans agree closely on tissue coverage (Dice = 0.957 ± 0.007 =0.957\pm 0.007 ), and pixel-level rendering quality reaches a mean PSNR of 14.83 ± 0.99 14.83\pm 0.99 dB ( Equation 13 ).
blocks.zh: 每像素的衰减系数μ \ mu首先被优化, 背向分数α \ alpha 被固定在统一处(第1阶段), 假设是15分贝的噪音地层。 在每个患者的每一个帧上,回收的OAC地图都有空间解析,并跟踪原始图像中可见的组织架构,解决了船壁,卢门边界和钙化平板矿床,证实框架概括了由被控制的幻象到以导管为基础的复杂的射线扫描IV-OCT. 利用已恢复的μ\mu地图,前向模型合成出能复制出每个截面整体几何的IV-OCT图像. 在所有29,269个帧上,制成和靶B-扫描器对组织覆盖度(Dice = 0.957 ± 0.007 = 0.957\pm 0.007),像素级渲染质量达到平均PSNR为14.83± 0.99 14.83\pm 0.99分贝(方程式13.

blocks.en:
The Stage 1 residual maps (right column of Figure 5 ) reveal structured, non-random differences concentrated along the inner wall. These arise because μ \mu plays a dual role in the Beer-Lambert forward model as in Equation 5 : it controls per-pixel brightness and cumulative attenuation, so the optimizer must satisfy both simultaneously with a single variable. Introducing a per-pixel backscattering parameter α \alpha (Stage 2) decouples these roles: μ \mu is frozen and α ∈ [ 10 − 10 , 10 − 2 ] \alpha\in[10^{-10},10^{-2}] is optimized as an independent brightness term. This reduces residuals across the cohort and raises the mean PSNR to 22.63 ± 0.74 22.63\pm 0.74 dB (Dice = 0.954 ± 0.009 =0.954\pm 0.009 ; Figure 5 , bottom row) without altering the recovered attenuation structure. A detailed derivation of the brightness-attenuation coupling and the two-stage procedure is provided in Supplementary Note 6.
The recovered maps carry information that the standalone IV-OCT image does not. Pixel brightness is not a tissue property. It confounds local backscattering with the cumulative attenuation of every voxel already traversed, the confocal gate, and an arbitrary system gain such that identical tissue appears at different intensities depending on depth and position relative to the catheter. Inverting the forward model removes these confounders so equal μ \mu denotes equal optical property anywhere in the frame.

所取回的地图载有独立IV-OCT图像没有的信息. 像素亮度不是组织属性. 它混淆了局部的后退与已经穿行的每个阴道的累积收缩,相交道口,任意的系统得到这样的结果,即根据深度和位置相对于导管的不同,同一组织出现在不同的强度上. 倒置前置模型去除这些混沌者如此等同的μ \ mu 表示框架中任何地方的等同光学属性.

blocks.en: No pixel-level ground-truth attenuation exists for in vivo coronary tissue, so this experiment demonstrates that the method transfers unmodified to clinical acquisition geometry rather than validating recovered attenuation values. PSNR and Dice quantify forward-model fidelity, not the accuracy of μ \mu , which is demonstrated with the computational and physical phantoms.
blocks.zh: 在活体冠状组织中不存在像素级地真衰减,因此这一实验表明,该方法没有被修改为临床获取几何,而不是验证恢复的衰减值。 PSNR和Dice量化了前置模型的忠诚度,而不是μ\mu的精确度,这与计算和物理的幽灵一起被证明.

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: We investigated whether intrinsic tissue properties can be recovered directly from medical images by recasting property extraction as an inverse problem that explicitly accounts for the system-dependent effects of image formation rather than a post-processing task. We tested this hypothesis in OCT by developing a differentiable inverse rendering framework that recovers the optical attenuation coefficient (OAC) per pixel from a single OCT image, without training data or prior segmentation. By embedding the Beer-Lambert model as a differentiable forward operator and optimizing μ \mu directly via gradient descent, the framework produces per-pixel parameters with direct physical meaning and an optimization procedure decoupled from the imaging configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了能否直接从医疗图像中恢复内在组织特性,办法是将财产提取重新制作成一个反向问题,明确说明图像形成对系统的影响,而不是处理后的任务。 我们在OCT中测试了这一假说,开发出一种不同的反向渲染框架,从单个OCT图像中回收每像素的光学衰减系数(OAC),而无需训练数据或事先分解. 通过将Beer-Lambert模型嵌入为可分化的前置操作器,并直接通过梯度回落来优化μ \ mu,框架产生有直接物理意义的每个像素参数,并实现与成像配置脱钩的优化程序.

blocks.en: The optimizer comparison supports gradient-based attenuation recovery as the number of axially coupled parameters increases ( Figure 1 ). All four methods achieve low error at small problem sizes, but the gradient-free algorithms lose accuracy as dimensionality grows. Random Search runs only a forward pass, so its computational cost stays flat, but its error grows steadily with problem size. CMA-ES fails on both fronts. Its error also grows with dimensionality, and each evaluation updates a covariance matrix whose size grows as the square of the number of parameters, making it computationally prohibitive at large sizes. Adam adds only a backward pass to compute gradients, while L-BFGS-B additionally maintains a short history of recent gradient and position updates to build its quasi-Newton search direction. Only the gradient-based methods remain viable across the full scaling range, underscoring the necessity of gradient information for high-dimensional inverse problems in imaging.
blocks.zh: 优化者比较支持以梯度为基础的衰减恢复,因为轴相接参数的数目有所增加(图1)。 所有四种方法都以小问题大小实现低误差,但随着维度的增大,无梯度算法失去精度. 随机 搜索只运行一个前传,因此其计算成本保持不变,但其出错随问题大小而稳步增加. CMA-ES在两个方面都失败了. 其误差也随着维度的增大而增加,每次评价都更新了同位素矩阵,其大小会随着参数数的平方而增加,使其在计算上在大尺寸时令人无法承受. 亚当只添加了后传来计算梯度,而L-BFGS-B则额外维持了最近梯度和位置更新的短暂历史来构建其准牛顿搜索方向. 只有以梯度为基础的方法在全缩放范围内仍然可行,强调成像中高维反向问题需要梯度信息.

blocks.en: We then verified numerical correctness on synthetic phantoms ( Figure 2 ), and we examined 5,120 inversions on liquid intralipid phantoms and found that recovered OAC tracks scatterer concentration linearly ( R 2 = 0.990 R^{2}=0.990 – 0.993 0.993 ) with slopes of 0.629 0.629 – 0.663 0.663 mm -1 % under CF-derived gain calibration ( Figure 3 ), and that agar-phantom recovery is reproducible across initializations (CoV = 0.18 % 0.18\% – 0.32 % 0.32\% ; Figure 4 ). The noise robustness study confirmed that recovery degrades predictably with decreasing SNR: across every phantom, baseline concordance and per-pixel spatial consistency tracked SNR monotonically, while recovered μ \mu deviated only marginally from its noiseless value over the first few dB of added noise and diverged sharply only once noise approached the signal amplitude. The physics-based forward model therefore acts as a stable regularizer across realistic acquisition SNRs and loses this regularization only when the signal itself is lost. The OCT inverse problem is fundamentally ill-posed, meaning that many distinct attenuation maps can produce nearly identical observed images. Our reproducible recovery across initializations indicates that the physics-based forward model yields consistent tissue-mean attenuation within the initialization ranges examined, and agreement with CF in liquid intralipid phantoms ( Figure 3 ) supports the accuracy of tissue-mean recovery.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们核实了合成幽灵上的数值正确性(图2),并检查了液相内脂幽灵上的5,120个倒置,发现回收的OAC轨道散射器浓度线性(R 2 = 0.990 R^{2}=0.990 – 0.993 0.993),坡度为0.629 0.629 – 0.663 mm-1%,在CF衍生增益校正下(图3),agar-幽灵回收可跨初始化复制(CoV = 0.18%-0.32%;图4). 噪声强度研究证实,随着SNR的减少,恢复可预期地会退化:在每一个幽灵、基线相和每像素空间一致性中,单向跟踪SNR,而所恢复的μ \ mu在最初几分多出噪声后,只略微偏离了它的无噪声值,仅在噪声接近信号振幅后,才急剧地相去甚远。 因此,以物理为基础的前向模型在现实的获取SNRs之间起到稳定的常态化作用,只有在信号本身丢失时才会失去这种常态化. OCT反向问题基本上是不易出现,这意味着许多明显的衰减地图可以产生几乎相同的被观测到的图像. 我们在初始化过程中的可再生产恢复表明,以物理为基础的前向模型在所检查的初始化范围内产生一致的组织-平均衰减,与液体内脂幽灵中的CF(图3)的一致支持了组织-平均恢复的准确性。

blocks.en: Applying the same algorithm to clinical coronary IV-OCT without modification recovered spatially resolved OAC maps ( Figure 5 ), demonstrating that physics-based recovery transfers across acquisition geometries in a data-agnostic way that learned methods cannot achieve without retraining. The recovered maps produce synthesized images that match the acquired B-scans with a mean PSNR of 14.83 ± 0.99 14.83\pm 0.99 dB, a modest value explained by the dual role that the OAC in the Beer-Lambert forward model plays in both per-pixel brightness and cumulative attenuation along depth. The optimizer must find a single μ \mu map that simultaneously satisfies both constraints. Introducing a per-pixel backscattering parameter α \alpha decouples these roles and raises the mean PSNR to 22.63 ± 0.74 22.63\pm 0.74 dB (Supplementary Note 6) without altering the recovered attenuation structure. This sequential procedure, constrained by literature-informed bounds on μ \mu and α \alpha Chang and Bowden (2019) ; Cannon et al. (2021) , reduces but does not remove the ambiguity between attenuation and backscattering in a single intensity image. The modest μ \mu -only PSNR therefore reflects the under-specification of the single-parameter forward model rather than a failure of the inversion procedure. Despite lack of absolute calibration, the recovered maps preserve spatial contrast consistent with anatomical features, which is the primary signal used in clinical decision-making.
blocks.zh: 对临床冠状物IV-OCT应用同一种算法而无需修改可回收的空间解析的OAC地图(图5),表明物理学基于获取几何的恢复转移方式是数据不可知的,而学习的方法如果不再培训,就无法实现. 被回收的地图产生的合成图像与获得的B-scans相匹配,平均PSNR为14.83±0.99 14.83\pm 0.99 dB,这一价值不大,其解释在于啤酒-兰伯特前方模型中的OAC在每像素亮度和相沿深度的累积衰减都扮演了双重角色. 优化者必须找到单一的 μ\ mu 映射, 同时满足两种限制 。 引入了每像素回转参数α-α去除这些作用,并将平均PSNR提高到22.63±0.74 22.63\pm 0.74 dB(补充说明6)而不会改变所恢复的衰减结构. 这种相继程序受到文献知情的μ\mu和α\alpha Chang和Bowden(2019年);Cannon等人(2021年)的限制,缩小了但并没有去除在单一强度图像中衰减和反射之间的模糊. 因此,微小的 μ\mu - 只有 PSNR 反映了单参数前置模型的规格不足,而不是倒置程序的失败. 尽管缺乏绝对校正,所回收的地图仍然保持了符合解剖特征的空间对比,这是临床决策中使用的主要信号.

blocks.en: The ability to extract a well-established tissue biomarker van der Meer et al. (2005) ; Van Soest et al. (2010) directly from routine IV-OCT imaging has direct implications for interventional cardiology, where treatment decisions hinge on tissue composition that is often inferred indirectly from anatomical features observed in imaging. Attenuation-based plaque assessment has already reached commercial deployment in the form of the OCT-derived index of plaque attenuation, which discriminates high-risk plaque features in vivo against expert consensus OCT classification Cai et al. (2025) , and this supports that the underlying signal carries clinical meaning. Such systems are, however, closed and vendor-bound pipelines that reduce a region to a single aggregate index, whereas the framework presented here recovers attenuation per pixel through an explicit forward model that can be substituted to recover other optical properties without altering the inversion. Per-pixel OAC maps could serve as a quantitative substrate for decisions that depend on spatial contrast, including vulnerable-plaque identification, calcified-region delineation for lithotripsy or atherectomy planning, and objective monitoring of plaque evolution across serial acquisitions of the same patient. Because the inversion depends on forward physics rather than a learned prior tied to specific scanners and samples, such analyses can be applied retrospectively to existing IV-OCT archives. These applications are most directly enabled once absolute calibration is available; the results here demonstrate the spatially resolved intrinsic properties and the relative contrast that would underpin them.
blocks.zh: 提取已建立良好的组织生物标志的能力 van der Meer等人(2005年); 苏斯特等. (2010年)直接取自常规IV-OCT成像对干预性心脏病学有直接影响,治疗决定取决于组织组成,而组织组成往往从成像中观察到的解剖特征中间接推断出. 基于加速的平板评估已经以OCT衍生出平板减缩指数的形式实现了商业部署,该指数在活体中区别了高危险平板特征与专家共识OCT分级Cai等人(2025年),这证明基础信号具有临床意义. 然而,这种系统是封闭的和以供应商为主的管道,将一个区域降低为单一的总指数,而这里提出的框架则通过一个明确的前向模型来恢复每像素的衰减,这种模型可以被取而代之,以回收其他光学特性而不会改变反向。 每个像素的OAC地图可以作为依赖于空间对比的决定的定量底物,包括脆弱-平面识别,为利他分解或剖面规划进行钙化区域划分,以及客观地监测同一患者在整个连环购买过程中的平面演变。 由于倒置取决于前向物理,而不是事先与特定的扫描仪和样品捆绑起来的所学,因此这种分析可以追溯应用于现有的IV-OCT档案. 这些应用在绝对校准后最直接地被启用;这里的结果显示了空间解析的内在特性以及支撑这些特性的相对对比.

blocks.en: We observed a systematic underestimation of recovered attenuation relative to curve-fitting references, but the difference was small at every concentration ( 0.083 0.083 – 0.176 0.176 mm -1 ), and concentration slopes were close to CF under shared gain calibration ( Figure 3 f). Both methods share the homogeneous Beer-Lambert limit, but CF fits a single attenuation to each depth window, acting as a first-order approximation of the signal decay, while DiffOCT fits an attenuation value at every depth pixel under TV regularization. The DiffOCT prediction therefore tracks the measured signal closely, whereas the CF line behaves as a regression line through it, with lower intensity RMSE for DiffOCT in both example A-lines ( Figure 3 g). The small offset is consistent with this difference in model order. In these homogeneous samples, part of the local variation that DiffOCT follows reflects residual speckle and noise, so lower RMSE indicates closer signal reproduction rather than more accurate attenuation by itself. DiffOCT thus reproduces the CF attenuation to within 0.2 0.2 mm -1 while additionally resolving attenuation with depth, which a single slope cannot represent in heterogeneous tissue. Because the loss mask is fixed from measured intensities, the offset does not arise from predictions falling below the noise floor and being excluded from the loss. Such systematic offsets are pervasive in the existing OAC retrieval literature. Reported values for calcified plaque alone span an order of magnitude depending on the estimation method, from 11.1 ± 4.9 11.1\pm 4.9 mm -1 by curve fitting on averaged A-scans van der Meer et al. (2005) to 0.87 ± 0.24 0.87\pm 0.24 mm -1 by depth-resolved analysis Liu et al. (2017) , yet the relative ordering of tissue types is preserved within each study Chang and Bowden (2019) . Tissue differentiation depends on the relative ordering of the OAC across tissues rather than on absolute magnitudes, and our recovered OAC preserves this ordering through a linear relationship to intralipid concentration across the phantom series. This has important implications for clinical settings. When scanner-specific calibration metadata is unavailable, recovered OAC values are no longer absolute but retain the within-slice relative contrast needed for tissue discrimination. Methods to convert relative OAC into absolute cross-patient values, such as reference-tissue anchoring or self-calibrating forward models, will be vital for extending the framework to cases requiring population-level comparisons such as drug-trial endpoints.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到,相对于曲线调整参考物,对恢复的衰减有系统低估,但每个浓度的差异很小(0.083 0.083 – 0.176 0.176 mm-1),在共享收益校准下,浓度坡度接近CF(图3f)。 这两种方法都具有同质的啤酒-兰伯特极限,但CF符合每个深度窗口的单个衰减,作为信号衰减的一阶近似值,而DiffOCT则符合电视规范化下每个深度像素的衰减值. 因此,DiffOCT预测对所测量的信号进行紧密跟踪,而CF线则通过它表现为回归线,在两个例子A-行中DiffOCT的强度RMSE更低(图3克). 按型号顺序,小额相抵与这一差异一致。 在这些同质样本中,DiffOCT所遵循的部分局部变异反应出残留分光和噪声,因此下RMSE表示信号复制更加接近,而不是自己更精确地减弱. 因此,DiffOCT可复制CF衰减到0.2毫米至0.2毫米以内,同时能以深度进一步解决衰减问题,而单个坡度不能在多样组织中代表。 由于损失面罩由所测强度所固定,所以抵消并不出自低于噪音底部并被排除在损失之外的预测. 此类系统抵消在现有的业务协调干事检索文献中普遍存在。 根据估算方法,仅钙化平板的报出值就从11.1± 4.9 11.1\pm 4.9 mm-1乘以平均A-scans van der Meer等人(2005年)的曲线,到0.87±0.24 0.87\pm 0.24 mm-1乘以深度溶解分析 刘等 (2017年),然而组织类型相对顺序在每次研究中保留. 张和鲍登 (2019). 组织分化取决于OAC在组织之间的相对顺序,而不是绝对的分量,我们恢复的OAC通过线性关系保持了这一顺序,跨越了幽灵系列的内脂浓度. 这对临床环境有重要影响. 在没有扫描仪专用的校准元数据时,恢复的OAC值不再是绝对值,而是保留组织歧视所需的切片内相对对比. 将相对的OAC转换成绝对跨病人值的方法,如参考-tissue s锚定或自我校正前方模型,对于将框架扩大到药物审判终点等需要人口一级比较的案件至关重要。

blocks.en: Solving this inversion at clinically relevant scales is tractable only because of the structural advantage of gradient information. Each backward pass delivers one derivative per parameter, while gradient-free methods update based on a scalar loss whose information content does not scale with problem size ( Figure 1 ), which explains the convergence failure in gradient-free approaches with increasing problem size. Beyond this computational tractability, physics-based differentiable inverse rendering carries two deployment advantages over analytical and data-driven methods that are particularly relevant for digital health. First, the framework is fully modular. The forward model, optimizer, and regularization terms can each be modified independently without restructuring the inversion procedure. This flexibility is unavailable to closed-form analytical approaches, which require the forward physics to admit an analytical inverse, and to learning-based approaches, which are coupled to the physics of their training distribution. Second, because the inversion is agnostic to acquisition configuration, it naturally sidesteps the scanner-to-scanner domain shift that is the dominant barrier to clinical deployment, allowing a single implementation to serve heterogeneous clinical environments regardless of scanner vendor, acquisition protocol, or post-processing pipeline. As physics-based differentiable models become increasingly common across medical imaging, including ultrasound Simson et al. (2023) ; Bertramo et al. (2025) , X-ray Gopalakrishnan et al. (2024) , and MRI Finkelstein et al. (2025) , their shared portability and interpretability provide a foundation for quantitative imaging tools that can scale across the infrastructure of digital health.
blocks.zh: 由于梯度信息在结构上具有优势,因此在临床相关尺度上解决这种倒置是可拉动的。 每个后传每个参数都给出了1个衍生出,而无梯度方法的更新则基于信息内容不以问题大小为尺度的分级损失(图1),这解释了无梯度方法的趋同失败,问题大小越来越大. 除了这种可计算性外,基于物理学的不同反向渲染具有两个部署优势,而不是对数字健康特别相关的分析和数据驱动方法。 首先,框架是完全模块化的。 前进模型,优化器,规范化术语可以各自独立修改而无需调整倒置程序. 这种灵活性对于封闭式分析方法来说是不存在的,它要求前向物理学承认分析反向的,对于以学习为基础的方法来说也是没有的,这些方法与它们的培训分布的物理学是相辅相成的。 其次,由于反向对获取配置是不可知的,它自然会回避扫描器到扫描器域位转移,这是临床部署的主要障碍,允许单一实施为不同的临床环境服务,无论扫描器供应商,采购协议,或处理后管道如何. 由于基于物理学的不同模型在医学成像中越来越普遍,包括超声波Simson等人(2023年)、Bertramo等人(2025年)、X射线Gopalakrishnan等人(2024年)和MRI Finkelstein等人(2025年),它们共享的可移植性和可解释性为能够跨越数字健康基础设施的定量成像工具奠定了基础。

blocks.en: However, while our framework can recover per-pixel OAC from clinical OCT images without retraining, it has several limitations. First, full optimization is computationally costly (approximately 35–50 s per B-scan on a modern GPU; Supplementary Note 4), which is tractable for offline research but incompatible with real-time catheter-lab use. Second, the clinical demonstration was conducted without access to scanner-specific system parameters or post-processing metadata, so the recovered values should be interpreted as evidence of geometric transfer and relative attenuation extraction rather than population-level clinical validation of absolute OAC values. This can be overcome in future developments by having access to the raw data and optical specifications of the scanner. Related to this, no reference standard for per-pixel attenuation exists in vivo, since histology is destructive and cannot be registered to individual OCT pixels. Third, our forward model is a simplified intensity-domain formulation that omits phase, coherent interference, and the speckle realization that arises from them. We adopt this simplification deliberately because phase-resolved simulation requires scanner-specific spectral parameters that are unavailable for retrospective clinical data. Speckle is nonetheless pervasive in IV-OCT and, because μ \mu is fitted at every pixel, residual speckle can appear as local attenuation fluctuations ( Figure 3 g). In the phantom experiments, we mitigate this using Gaussian spatial filtering applied to input B-scans, which other despeckling methods can replace, and an anisotropic total-variation penalty (Eq. ( 8 )) that encourages spatial homogeneity within tissue regions. Fourth, tissue-mean recovery is reproducible across seeds (CoV = 0.18 % =0.18\% – 0.32 % 0.32\% ) and the seven selected initialization conditions (CoV = 2.1 % =2.1\% – 13.1 % 13.1\% ; Figure 4 c–d), but more aggressive perturbations of the initialization range produce different recovered values. Initialization-induced uncertainty in the clinical tissue means and individual pixels is quantified in Supplementary Note 8. Lastly, the single-scattering Beer-Lambert forward model may become insufficient at higher optical depths and in cases where multiple scattering dominates, although preliminary comparisons with the Extended Huygens-Fresnel model ( g = 0.7 g=0.7 , a value previously used for tissue in OCT simulations Hartinger et al. (2014) ) yielded nearly identical recovered attenuation at our phantom concentrations (mean difference < 1 % <1\% ; Supplementary Note 5).
blocks.zh: 然而,虽然我们的框架可以从临床OCT图像中恢复每像素OAC,而不进行再培训,但它有几种局限性. 首先,全面优化在计算上成本很高(现代GPU上每B-scan大约35-50 s;补充说明4),可用于离线研究,但与实时导管-实验室使用不相容. 其次,临床演示是在无法获取扫描仪专用系统参数或加工后元数据的情况下进行的,因此所回收的数值应被解释为几何转移和相对衰减提取的证据,而不是人口一级对OAC绝对值的临床验证. 在今后的发展过程中,可以通过获得扫描仪的原始数据和光学规格来克服这一点。 与此相关,在活体中不存在每像素衰减的参考标准,因为组织学具有破坏性,不能注册给单个OCT像素. 第三,我们的前向模型是一种简化的强度域配方,它省略了相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 我们有意采用这种简化,因为相相解模拟需要扫描仪专用光谱参数,而这种光谱参数无法用于追溯性临床数据。 尽管如此,Speckle在IV-OCT中是普遍存在的,由于μ\mu被安装在每个像素上,所剩的Speckle可以作为局部衰减波动出现(图3克). 在幽灵实验中,我们利用应用于输入B-扫描仪的高斯空间滤取法(其他分辨法可以取代)和鼓励组织区域内空间同质化的异同位素总变异性分解法(Eq. (8))来减轻这种情况. 第四,组织-正体恢复可跨种子(CoV = 0.18% = 0.18 = 0.32 = 0.32 = )和选定的七个初始化条件(CoV = 2.1% = 2.1% = 2.1% = 13.1% = 13.1 = = ; 图4 c-d)再生,但初始化范围的更积极的扰动会产生不同的被恢复值. 初始化引发的临床组织手段和个人像素的不确定性在补充说明8中量化. 最后,在光学深度较高和多发散占主导地位的情况下,单发啤酒-兰伯特前置模型可能变得不足,尽管与扩展惠更斯-弗雷斯内尔模型(克=0.7克=0.7,以前OCT模拟Hartinger等人(2014年)中用于组织的价值)的初步比较使我们的幽灵浓度产生几乎相同的恢复衰减(平均差异 < 1% < 1*;补充说明5)。

blocks.en: This work highlights several directions for extension. Posterior sampling and Bayesian inverse-problem formulations can attach per-pixel uncertainty bounds to recovered OAC and characterize the local-minima behavior we observed under aggressive initialization perturbation. More thorough treatment of multiple-scattering forward models can extend quantitative recovery into deeper tissue regimes, building on the Extended Huygens-Fresnel implementation reported in Supplementary Note 5. Joint estimation of system parameters such as z f z_{f} and z R z_{R} with μ \mu is a natural extension of the framework and should be feasible with constraints that make these parameters identifiable.

blocks.en: This framework permits quantitative tissue characterization from routine clinical intravascular imaging using physics-based differentiable inverse rendering. By recovering physically interpretable attenuation maps from a single IV-OCT image without training data or scanner calibration, it can support interventional cardiologists in plaque characterization and treatment planning, and enable retrospective analysis of existing IV-OCT archives.
blocks.zh: 这个框架允许通过基于物理学的不同反向渲染,从常规临床血管内成像中进行定量组织特征鉴定. 通过从单一的IV-OCT图像中取回物理可判读的还原图而无需培训数据或扫描仪校正,它可以在平板特征描述和治疗规划中支持干预性心脏病学家,并能够对现有IV-OCT档案进行回溯分析.

blocks.en: The framework recovers per-pixel optical properties from a measured OCT B-scan by iteratively optimizing a differentiable forward model to reproduce the observed image (Fig. 6 ). Given a log-scaled target B-scan I target ​ ( z , x ) I_{\text{target}}(z,x) , where z z denotes depth and x x the lateral A-line index, the method initializes a spatial map of tissue attenuation coefficients μ ⁡ ( z , x ) \mu(z,x) and passes it through a physics-based forward model ℱ \mathcal{F} that simulates OCT image formation, producing a predicted B-scan I ^ ​ ( z , x ) = ℱ ​ ( μ , 𝜽 ) \hat{I}(z,x)=\mathcal{F}(\mu;\boldsymbol{\theta}) , where 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} denotes the fixed system parameters (focal geometry, pixel size, noise floor, and system gain). A masked mean squared error (MSE) loss, with total variation (TV) regularization on μ \mu for spatial smoothness, is computed between I ^ \hat{I} and I target I_{\text{target}} over tissue pixels identified by a noise floor mask. Because the forward model is implemented as a differentiable computational graph in PyTorch Paszke et al. (2017) , the gradient ∂ ℒ / ∂ μ \partial\mathcal{L}/\partial\mu is obtained via automatic differentiation, and μ \mu is updated by the Adam optimizer. After convergence, the final μ ⁡ ( z , x ) \mu(z,x) map represents the recovered depth-resolved optical attenuation coefficient at each pixel.

blocks.en: To verify numerical correctness of the forward and inverse models, we conducted two complementary tests. First, the forward model was evaluated on 500 synthetic A-lines, each containing 2 to 5 homogeneous layers with randomized attenuation coefficients drawn from [ 0.1 , 15.0 ] [0.1,15.0] mm -1 . With the confocal function disabled, system gain set to unity, and α = 1 \alpha=1 , the forward model output was compared pixel-by-pixel against the analytical Beer-Lambert solution computed independently. Agreement was quantified by the coefficient of determination ( R 2 R^{2} ) and the maximum absolute error across all pixels.
blocks.zh: 为了验证前向模型和倒向模型的数值正确性,我们进行了两次补充测试。 首先,对远期模型进行了500条合成A-线的评估,每条A-线包含2至5个同质地层,随机分解的衰减系数取自[0.1, 15.0] [0.1, 15.0]毫米-1. 由于concol函数被禁用,系统增益设定为统一,而α = 1\ alpha=1,将前置模型输出的像素逐像素与独立计算的分析啤酒-兰伯特解决方案相比较. 协议通过确定系数(R 2 R^{2})和所有像素的最大绝对误差量化.

blocks.en: Second, the inverse optimization was evaluated on 500 synthetic B-scans with spatially varying, per-pixel ground-truth attenuation. Each B-scan was generated by the forward model with known μ \mu , α \alpha , confocal parameters, and system gain. The attenuation map was then scrambled to random initial values and recovered by the optimizer over 30,000 iterations, with α \alpha and G dB G_{\text{dB}} frozen at their true values to isolate the recovery of μ \mu .
blocks.zh: 第二,对500个合成B-扫描仪进行了反向优化评估,这些扫描仪的空间差异很大,每像素地面真实度有所降低。 每个 B- scan 是由前置模型生成的 有已知的 μ\ m , α\ alpha , 集合参数和系统增益 。 衰减图随后被扭曲为随机初始值并被优化器回收了超过30,000次迭代,α\α和G dB G_{\text{dB}}以真实值被冻结来隔离μ\mu的回收.

Axial spacing was Δ ​ z = 0.16 / K \Delta z=0.16/K mm; focal position and Rayleigh range in pixels were rescaled to preserve the physical confocal geometry. Random Search Solis and Wets (1981) , CMA-ES Hansen and Ostermeier (2001) , Adam Kingma and Ba (2014) , and L-BFGS-B Byrd et al. (1995) shared the target, masks, fixed gain and backscattering fraction, OAC bounds of [ 0.01 , 20 ] [0.01,20] mm -1 , and eight paired initializations drawn uniformly from [ 0.01 , 10 ] [0.01,10] mm -1 . Each optimizer used a nominal budget of 20,000 iterations (Adam, Random Search, and L-BFGS-B) or objective evaluations (CMA-ES). Recovery accuracy was quantified by the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) between recovered and ground-truth tissue attenuation: MAPE = 1 | 𝒯 | ​ ∑ ( z , x ) ∈ 𝒯 | μ ^ ​ ( z , x ) − μ true ​ ( z , x ) | μ true ​ ( z , x ) × 100 % , \text{MAPE}=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{T}|}\sum_{(z,x)\in\mathcal{T}}\frac{|\hat{\mu}(z,x)-\mu_{\text{true}}(z,x)|}{\mu_{\text{true}}(z,x)}\times 100\%, (10) where 𝒯 \mathcal{T} denotes the set of tissue pixels. The MAPE is evaluated on the recovered attenuation coefficient rather than on image intensity. Wall-clock time per evaluation (ms/eval) was also recorded to quantify per-iteration compute cost. Per-evaluation cost differs across methods because each evaluation carries different work: Random Search runs only a forward pass; Adam adds a backward pass to compute gradients; L-BFGS-B additionally maintains a running history of past gradients to build its quasi-Newton search direction, and that bookkeeping cost grows as the parameter count increases; CMA-ES on top of evaluation must update and occasionally re-decompose a covariance matrix over the parameters, so its per-evaluation cost climbs steeply with problem size and dominates at large problem scales. blocks.en: Identifiability
blocks.zh: 可识别性

blocks.en: The identifiability study tested whether the recovered attenuation is independent of optimization randomness and initialization. In the first experiment, each acquisition was optimized 20 times with different random seeds controlling the initial μ \mu values, while keeping all other parameters fixed. The coefficient of variation (CoV) of the recovered tissue μ \mu across seeds was used to quantify reproducibility. In the second experiment, the initialization range was varied across 10 conditions spanning narrow ( [ 1 , 1 ] [1,1] mm -1 ), wide ( [ 0 , 20 ] [0,20] mm -1 ), and biased ( [ 7 , 15 ] [7,15] mm -1 ) ranges, with 5 seeds per condition per acquisition. Agreement of the converged μ \mu across initialization conditions was assessed by the CoV and by the range of recovered tissue means.
blocks.zh: 可识别性研究测试了恢复的衰减是否独立于优化随机和初始化. 在第一次实验中,每次获得被优化了20次,不同的随机种子控制了初始μ\mu值,同时保持了所有其他参数的固定. 利用种子间回收的μ\mu组织变异系数量化可再生性。 在第二次实验中,初始化范围在10个条件之间有所变化,范围包括:狭窄([1, 1] [1,1]毫米-1];宽([0, 20] [0,20]毫米-1];偏差([7, 15] [7,15]毫米-1])范围,每个条件获得5个种子. COV和回收的组织手段范围评估了在初始化条件下趋同的μ \ mu的一致性。

blocks.en: Noise Robustness

blocks.en: Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: 统计分析

blocks.en: All quantitative analyses were performed in Python (v3.10) using NumPy (v1.24), SciPy (v1.11), and Matplotlib (v3.7). The study is descriptive throughout: no inferential hypothesis tests were applied, as this work compares recovered properties to known references and reports per-pixel error distributions rather than testing population effects. Continuous quantities computed across frames, phantoms, or random seeds are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation unless otherwise noted, and per-pixel distributions are summarized by median, mean absolute error, and the fraction of pixels within fixed dB tolerance envelopes ( ± 3 \pm 3 , ± 10 \pm 10 , ± 20 \pm 20 dB). For the phantom validation, linear regression of recovered tissue attenuation against intralipid concentration was fit by ordinary least squares and reported as slope, intercept, and the coefficient of determination R 2 R^{2} . For the identifiability study, the within-acquisition coefficient of variation (CoV) of recovered tissue-mean μ \mu was computed as the standard deviation divided by the mean across the perturbation set and reported as a percentage. Initialization-range CoV was computed after averaging five seeds per condition, using the seven selected phantom conditions or all ten clinical conditions ( Figure 4 c,d and Supplementary Figure 8b). For the noise robustness study, recovery degradation was quantified as the absolute relative change in recovered tissue μ \mu versus the noiseless baseline ( | Δ ​ μ | / μ baseline |\Delta\mu|/\mu_{\text{baseline}} ), and spatial agreement was tracked as the pixel-wise R 2 R^{2} of recovered μ \mu versus the noiseless baseline at each SNR.

blocks.en: The physical phantom experiments involved no human subjects, animal subjects, or biological tissue and required no ethical approval. All protected health information was de-identified according to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) requirements, and identifiers such as names and birth dates were removed from structured data sources.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Gradient-based optimization maintains attenuation recovery accuracy as the number of coupled depth parameters increases. Solid curves show attenuation MAPE against known ground truth ( Equation 10 ); dashed curves show wall time per objective evaluation. Problem size K K counts depth parameters in one synthetic A-line, spanning eight sizes from 25 to 5,000 within a fixed 0.16 mm tissue band. Random Search, CMA-ES, Adam, and L-BFGS-B share the forward model, bounds, and initial values, with TV disabled and solver-specific optimization budgets. GF and GB denote gradient-free and gradient-based optimizers, respectively. Points and error bars denote mean ± \pm one standard deviation across N = 8 N=8 paired initializations; curves interpolate the means. Timing includes solver overhead and is normalized by actual evaluation counts on NVIDIA Tesla V100-PCIE-32GB GPUs.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Clinical IV-OCT attenuation and backscattering fraction estimation. The framework was applied without modification to all 29,269 frames over the 128 patients. We show 5 representative cross-sections from a single pullback here. The white scale bars delineate 500 μ \mu m. Columns show, left to right: ground-truth IV-OCT (GT, dB); recovered OAC map ( μ \mu , mm -1 ); Stage 1 rendered image from OAC map with α = 1 \alpha=1 (dB); recovered per-pixel backscattering map ( α \alpha ); Stage 2 rendered image from the sequential μ + α \mu+\alpha model (dB); and the final pixel-wise residual (rendered − - ground-truth, dB). Recovered attenuation maps are spatially resolved across all frames and track the tissue architecture visible in the raw images, including the vessel wall, lumen boundary, and calcified deposits. Across the full 128-patient cohort, Stage 1 rendered images reproduce the target geometry with Dice = 0.957 ± 0.007 =0.957\pm 0.007 at the 15 dB noise floor and PSNR = 14.83 ± 0.99 =14.83\pm 0.99 dB. Optimizing α \alpha with μ \mu frozen (Stage 2) decouples per-pixel brightness from cumulative attenuation and raises the cohort-wide PSNR to 22.63 ± 0.74 22.63\pm 0.74 dB (Dice = 0.954 ± 0.009 =0.954\pm 0.009 ). Cohort values are mean ± \pm SD across N = 29,269 N=29{,}269 frames.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Framework overview. A measured OCT B-scan is compared against the output of a differentiable physics-based forward model. Automatic differentiation provides gradients of the reconstruction loss with respect to the per-pixel attenuation map μ ⁡ ( z , x ) \mu(z,x) , which is iteratively updated via gradient-based optimization until the predicted image matches the observed measurement. As optimization proceeds, the predicted OCT image I ^ ​ ( z , x ) \hat{I}(z,x) converges to the target image I target ​ ( z , x ) I_{\text{target}}(z,x) and the recovered attenuation map μ ⁡ ( z , x ) \mu(z,x) converges to our estimated optical attenuation coefficient at each pixel.
